scope: Topic relevance within the existing four-opportunity development corpus; not eligibility or full-dataset coverage.
labelling_rule: Relevant means the requested topic or activity is directly supported by the indexed title/description. Generic transferable usefulness is insufficient. All labels are manually authored, not externally adjudicated.
split_rule: Choose the score threshold using calibration only. Freeze it before evaluating the evaluation split; do not retune from evaluation errors.
